A few small possibilities

  • Walk with arrows or W A S D. Tap a path to walk there.
  • Meet Oona, Pella and Boro; E starts a conversation nearby.
  • Explore the pond edge to find creatures and peculiar treasures.
  • Go home with H. Choose a furnishing in your pocket, then tap a floor tile.
  • Tap placed furniture to rotate, move, or pocket it.
  • Bring three different pond finds for the town picnic.
  • Open your town to a friend, or paste their invitation to visit.

Guests explore, chat, collect, give gifts and contribute to the host’s picnic. Decorating the host’s home stays with the host.
